name: Sweet potato

schedule.notes: Plant slips (rooted shoots) into 70+ F soil. Use black plastic mulch in zones 6 and below.
Lift before first hard frost — frosted vines rot the tubers. Cure 7 to 14 days at 80 F.

harvest.cues: Test-dig one when vines start to yellow (or before first frost in cooler climates). Cure to sweeten and toughen skin.
harvest.storageNotes: Cure 7 to 14 days at 80 F and high humidity; then store at 55 to 60 F. Keeps 6 to 12 months.

varieties.name: Beauregard
varieties.notes: Classic orange flesh, fast-maturing. Good in shorter seasons.

varieties.name: Japanese Purple
varieties.notes: Purple skin, white flesh. Dry, chestnut-like flavor.

notes: Order slips for spring delivery — start your own from a grocery-store sweet potato in water 6 weeks ahead. Likes lean, sandy soil; rich soil grows leaves not tubers.
